purpose: A bounded public self-audit of AI Mastery's implementation and publication records.
publication_rule: Only facts and plainly labelled interpretations or frameworks may appear. Outcome claims remain omitted unless a dated, inspectable, owner-reviewed evidence record is added.

claims.statement: AI Mastery is a public static website hosted at virtualmase.github.io/ai-mastery/.
At the audit checkpoint, main includes a connected Knowledge Index plus ARM and Trust Infrastructure learning pathways.
The public repository includes llms.txt, sitemap.xml, and local-only structural validation scripts for the Knowledge Index, ARM pathway, and Trust pathway.
The combination of explicit learning boundaries, source shelves, and route discovery records is an effort to make the site easier to inspect by readers and systems.
claims.caveat: This is an interpretation of the implementation, not evidence of reader comprehension, search visibility, citation, or adoption.

claims.statement: This case study uses an inspect, record, correct, and recheck framework for self-auditing public implementation claims.
claims.caveat: The framework organizes review work; it does not certify a property or guarantee outcome quality.

claims.statement: Organic search, citation, referral, ranking, learner, commercial, and conversion outcomes are not established by this audit.
claims.caveat: No attributed analytics, user-research, Search Console, financial, or independent outcome record was inspected.
